entities.name: Marylin Rexroth testifies on the witness stand with an air of wounded innocence
entities.description: Marylin Rexroth takes the stand, presenting herself as shocked and innocently victimized while giving her testimony in court.

entities.name: Miles Massey recites poetry to challenge Marylin Rexroth's credibility
entities.description: Miles begins his cross-examination by dramatically reciting a poetic line about hardened hearts, unsettling Marylin and drawing an objection from Ruth.

entities.name: Ruth objects to Miles's poetic questioning as unprofessional
entities.description: Ruth raises an objection to the judge, citing 'poetry recitation' as improper grounds for cross-examination, calling it 'arty farty'.

entities.name: Miles shifts to metaphorical questioning about love and heart walls
entities.description: After the objection, Miles rephrases his approach, asking Marylin about the height of the wall around her heart and whether she has ever truly been in love.

entities.name: Marylin Rexroth affirms her love for her husband Rex during cross-examination
entities.description: Marylin states that she loved and always loved her husband Rex, quoting Shakespeare to support her claim of love at first sight.

entities.name: Miles concludes his cross-examination with feigned sympathy
entities.description: Miles ends his questioning by thanking Marylin, apologizing for causing her anguish, and signaling no further questions to the court.

entities.name: Bailiff offers assistance to Marylin as she leaves the stand
entities.description: After stepping down, a bailiff offers to help Marylin off the witness stand, which she politely declines.

entities.name: Ruth announces the defense rests its case
entities.description: Ruth informs the judge that the defense has no further witnesses or evidence to present and formally rests their case.

entities.name: Miles calls Patricia Kennedy DeCordoba Isenberg to the stand
entities.description: Miles announces the next witness for the prosecution, prompting a noticeable reaction from Marylin as she pauses while reseating herself.
